notes.title: Orbit Outlaws Livestream! Steam Remote Play Together Event
notes.content:
Hey Outlaws!

The first-ever Orbit Outlaws Livestream is happening on March 27th at 11 am PST during the Steam Remote Play together event. Join the developers and fans of Orbit Outlaws as we show off newly added features in 4-player PvP action as well as Steam's upgraded version of Remote Play. And yes, you can instantly share Orbit Outlaws with your friends or frenemies over the internet for free. with a simple invite through Steam.

notes.title: Big Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
Alright, Outlaws! First, a big thanks to each of you who've shared [url=https://discord.com/invite/hYmdrbX]feedback [/url]with us during this first month of Early Access. Please keep it coming! We're determined to make this the definitive physics-based arena combat game. 

We've been retooling some of the key systems based on those insights. Today, we're happy to share an updated build designed to make the game more fun and less chaotic. The changes revolve around three key themes: pacing, camera, and weapons.

[b]Pacing:[/b]
We've heard from several that the game is intensely chaotic, especially to new players just getting their bearings. While intense action is fundamental to our vision for the game, we believe we've overshot the mark a bit. We've taken the first steps to address this by modestly reducing clip sizes, firing rates, and bullet velocities across most weapons. We've also slightly slowed most chasses flight and boost speeds. Our hope is to preserve the intensity of the matches while increasing the opportunity for strategy and reducing bullet clouds.

There's work to be done still! We're exploring a slight expansion to the map sizes while continuing to refine the balance and profiles of each of the weapons. In the meanwhile, if you see something that can be improved, please say so in Discord! 

[b]The Camera:[/b]
Previously, our camera centered on your tank with a bias in the direction of your aim. This made it easy to know who you are in splitscreen, but it limited your view of the action, often leaving enemy tanks just on the periphery of your view. Further, we heard from a few that the limited visibility in 4-player split screen made it hard to anticipate dangers or pull off great shots. At times, it was downright claustrophobic.

In response, we've made the camera smarter. It now attempts to contain all four tanks in a single view, dynamically zooming, pulling back, and re-centering as the action evolves. Now it's easy to take aim at an opponent on the opposite side of the solar system and lob shots till you score the perfect hit. There are upper limits to the zoom factor beyond which the tanks are too small to be practical, so the camera will bias toward your tank's position to avoid losing you from view.  

[b]The Weapons[/b]
Players come in all shapes and sizes, each favoring a different style of play. We're working towards three gear archetypes that cater specifically to three playstyles:
[olist]
[*]Assualt: The assault mindset is simple - seek and destroy the nearest enemy. No retreat, no surrender. Assaults expect to deal damage and they expect to take it. Thus, assault weapons focus on high DPS with relatively low overall clip size, while assault chasses favor speed and high shielding so they can recover after a kill.
[*]Artillery: Artillery players don't move around much, preferring instead to stay firmly planted on planets and deal damage from downtown. They use planets as cover and take advantage of line-of-sight opportunities. In addition to lobbed shots, artillery weapons can be charged to fire fast and straight for a quick kill. Artillery chasses favor higher driving speed to use planets as cover, but they're slow while airborne.  
[*]Tactical: Tactical players are flexible, adapting their playstyles to the current situation. They pursue their advantage or they flee to fight another day as the occasion calls for. Tactical weapons are optimal at medium range and perform well while in flight. Tactical chasses focus on amplifying super abilities while providing great maneuverability for evasion and to take greater advantage of power-ups. 
[/olist]
In this build, you'll see our first steps towards this vision. A charge mechanic has been added to the artillery weapons (i.e. the Cannon) so you can both lob and fire a direct shot at exposed enemies all from the right trigger. Meanwhile, the assault weapons have been optimized for high damage output and low clip size (i.e. the hailstorm). There's more work to do on tactical.

notes.title: Free Demo!
notes.content:
The holidays are here, and we're slipping a little something extra into your stocking. The Orbit Outlaws demo has arrived! Now you can experience the definitive physics-based arena combat game completely free!

So gather friends to create new rivalries or stir up old ones in 4-player split screen action! The demo includes access to the following:
[olist]
[*] In single player, play the first campaign league to challenge the Elder
[*] In quick play, dive into Deathmatch in two community favorite maps: Haven and Chill Out 
[*] In the shop, access three chasses, three weapons, custom color schemes, and more.
[/olist]
When you're ready to experience it all, grab your copy of the full game. Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Update 0.52 - Happy "Tanksgiving", enjoy our latest chassis
notes.content:
Happy Turkey Day! We're celebrating the commemorative occasion with the release of our Hover chassis, hot out of the oven. If the Pilgrims could do it all over again, you can bet they'd have taken this bad boy. 

The Hover chassis offers balanced stats but trades its active mod slot for the ability to equip a second passive chassis mod.

We also include a plate full of fresh fixes for you. Check out these improvements in your next session:
[list]
[*] Pulled the camera back to see more of the map while not aiming
[*] The Spread Shot mod damage is now correctly reduced for all burst of the Repeater and the Hydra Missiles
[*] Clarified the format of the Campaign to indicate the three qualifier matches before the Rival battle
[*] Made the Shop button more prominent in the Garage and Campaign
[*] Resolved an issue where bots occasionally spin wildly when attempting to land
[*] Improvements to better identify which player you are in the scoring HUD
[*] Numerous improvements to the Auto Turret super: the health bar now reflects the relative health and shields, the shields now regenerate, receive damage from Lysten's super, Kistal's super, etc.
[*] When first entering the garage, Monsieur Seretti notifies you that new pilots can be unlocked in the campaign
[*] The Map selector is now centered in Quickplay Party
[*] When backing out an item details page in the shop, the selector now remains on your current selection
[*] Added sound effect and visuals for when the super ability is charged
[*] Updated the pilot tab in the garage to read "Locked Pilots"
[*] When selecting a random map, ensure the next map is always different than the previous
[/list]

P.S. Yes, that's a turkey tank. And no, don't try it at home.

notes.title: Update 0.5 - New weapon, bug fixes, and more
notes.content:
Every couple weeks we'll be adding additional content on our road to full release. This week, we're introducing the latest in our weapons line up: the Predator! The Predator's damage increases with each successive hit and is favorite among hit-and-run builds. Try pairing it with a fast chassis for a quick escape. The Predator is available to unlock starting at level 8. 

So trick your ride with the latest and get out there and hunt some prey. Then join the discussion on [url=https://discord.com/invite/hYmdrbX]discord [/url]to let us know what you think. 

This builds includes additional tweaks and improvements listed below:
-Resolved an issue where passive chassis mods weren't being properly displayed in the garage.
-Players first visit the garage when beginning a new campaign
-Optimized loading time hitches that occured when loading the main menu, when beginning a match, when ending a match. Some still remain in the Campaign.
-Added unique icons for each of the mods.
-Added an audio layer to accompany the campaign cut scenes.
-Added the name of the game mode to the pause screen
-The super activation now shows the correct key after customizing key bindings
-Added an audio stinger when sudden death begins
-Reduced the pitch of the UI sounds to be less harsh
-Oki's Nova Shield now protects you instantly on activation
-Changed the way the Nova Shield deals damage on exploding
-Resolved a bug where there was a chance the player could spawn in a match with an overshield
-Resolved minor graphical occlusions during the after action report in the campaign
-Disabled the winner graphic behind the after action report in the campaign.

notes.title: Join the Closed Beta on June 19th!
notes.content: Over the coming weeks, we'll onboard a select few users in preparation for our first ever Beta test on June 19th and 20th. These "Original Outlaws" will have the greatest influence on the shape of the product, and you'll be the first to access every update from now through release. You'll also receive an exclusive "Original Outlaws" skin for Oki when the game goes live. We're only offering 200 slots in our first wave, so if you're interested, head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/hYmdrbX]Discord [/url] or register for beta access at www.orbitoutlaws.com.
